items.description: Painting the disturbed wall area and closing the wall opening
items.rationale: Repair of the affected wall area after leak access is covered under 7.1.5 and 7.1.7(a,c); only the disturbed area is indemnified, not the whole room. Reference Case 36 (cleaning/repainting affected areas) and Case 27 (drying/repair/painting after leak) suggest a moderate, localised repair price.
One travel/call-out charge per contractor per invoice is indemnified (7.1.7(f)). Reference Case 27 and 34 show typical rates.
Consumable installation material used in the repair is covered (7.1.7(c)). Reference Case 34 and 27 show such items are included at modest cost.
Replacement pipe for the failed section is covered as part of the repair (7.1.7(c)). Reference Case 34 (copper pipe) and 27 (replacement section) suggest a moderate price for 1m.
Replacement of insulation removed for access is covered (7.1.7(c)), as in Case 34 and 27. Standard material, modest cost.
Labour for pipe repair is covered (7.1.7(g)). Reference Case 27 and 34 show typical hourly rates.
Flat-rate deployment of measuring equipment for leak detection or moisture measurement is covered once per drying/repair operation (7.1.7(e)). Reference Case 36 and 27 show typical rates.
Labour for leak tracing, repair, and drying setup is covered (7.1.7(g)). Reference Case 27 (technician hours for leak detection/repair) suggests a moderate hourly rate.
Only the first travel/call-out charge per contractor per invoice is indemnified (7.1.7(f)); subsequent charges are excluded.
Drying of the affected area is covered (7.1.7(b)), with a flat-rate deployment charge indemnified once per drying operation. Reference Case 27 and 36 (drying/dryer rental) suggest a moderate rate.
Contractor's own reusable tools and blades are not indemnified (7.1.8(b)). Reference Case 34 and 36 confirm exclusion.
Gunmetal fittings used in the pipe repair are covered as consumable installation material (7.1.7(c)). Reference Case 34 and 27 support modest cost for such items.
Second length of replacement pipe for the repair is covered (7.1.7(c)), as above.

items.description: Pipe insulation shell, 100 cm long 1 m
items.rationale: Second length of insulation for the replaced pipe is covered (7.1.7(c)), as above.

Labour for leak tracing, repair, and drying setup is covered (7.1.7(g)). If this is a duplicate of item 8, only the first such charge is indemnified (7.1.8(c)); if for a separate visit, both may be covered if work was needed on both. Reference Case 27 supports full coverage if justified.
